description: This file defines the interface IWebAudioPlayerClient for the Rialto web audio player. It declares a class with a virtual destructor and a pure virtual method notifyState, which is used to notify the client of changes in the playback state.

classes.name: IWebAudioPlayerClient
classes.description: An abstract base class for web audio player clients, providing a method to notify about playback state changes.

methods.name: ~IWebAudioPlayerClient
methods.description: Virtual destructor for the IWebAudioPlayerClient interface.

methods.name: notifyState
methods.description: Pure virtual method to notify the client of the current WebAudioPlayerState.
